Job Title: DevOps Engineer
Experience: 4-7 years
Location: Hybrid: Bengaluru, 3 days a week in the office.
Mandatory Skills:
- Kubernetes
- Jenkins
- AWS or Ansible

Good to have:
- Terraform
- Helm
- Grafana
- CI/CD

Responsibilities:
- Join AtlasWave Technologies' platform engineering team to design, build and maintain scalable containerized infrastructure for enterprise SaaS products.
- Implement, operate and optimize Kubernetes clusters across development and production environments, ensuring high availability and cost efficiency.
- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins to automate build, test and deployment workflows in collaboration with development teams.
- Use AWS or Ansible to provision and manage cloud infrastructure, enforce configuration management and automate routine operational tasks.
- Troubleshoot and resolve performance, reliability and deployment issues; participate in on-call rotation for critical incident response.
- Collaborate with developers to containerize applications, implement service discovery, secrets management and observability best practices.
- Contribute to infrastructure-as-code initiatives; write, review and maintain automation scripts and documentation.
- Mentor junior engineers, drive post-incident reviews and propose changes to improve operational maturity and deployment velocity.
